answer_1.quote: We introduce a conversational functioncalling benchmark targeting conversation phenomena such as follow-ups, goal correction and switching ... The benchmark includes over 80 API tools and tests function-calling up to 20+ APIs under different conversation lengths.
answer_1.outputs: function calls (structured API invocations) and textual agent responses

answer_2.quote: We leverage abstract syntax trees (AST) to evaluate function-calling turns similar to BFCL v2... We also perform an analysis on how often the models hallucinate parameters... The classifier predicts one or more dialog act labels... The classifier has a high recall but low precision.

answer_3.quote: We use an off-the-shelf LLM to do hallucination detection. The prompt includes the conversation history, the predicted action call ... We use gpt-4o-mini as an LLM judge... We use an LLM-based dialog act classifier that is prompted to generate one or more of the dialog acts for an agent response.
methods: hallucination detection via prompted LLM judge
dialog act classification via prompted LLM
criteria: dialog act categories (inform, seek_info, reject, function_call, other)
